definitions.explanation: A suggested course of action or scheme.
A concept or notion for doing something.
A preliminary version of a document or law.

notes:
{案|あん} has two main uses: a plan/idea, and a draft document or proposal. Very productive as a suffix in compound words.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {案|あん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to propose an idea
- {案|あん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧: an idea comes to mind
- {案|あん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧: to work out a plan
- ⟦{案|あん}の{定|じょう}→案の定：07578_annojou⟧: as expected (set phrase)

AS A SUFFIX (～{案|あん}):
- ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧: bill (legislation)
- ⟦{予算案|よさんあん}→予算案：09761_yosanan⟧: budget proposal
- ⟦{企画案|きかくあん}→企画案：27963_kikakuan⟧: project proposal
- ⟦{代案|だいあん}→代案：22236_daian⟧: alternative plan
- ⟦{名案|めいあん}→名案：15591_meian⟧: brilliant idea
- ⟦{改善案|かいぜんあん}→改善案：27964_kaizenan⟧: improvement proposal

USAGE:
⟦{案|あん}の{定|じょう}→案の定：07578_annojou⟧ (as expected, sure enough) is a common set phrase where {案|あん} retains its older meaning of "expectation."
